incidents.what_happened: Two sisters riding a scooter towards Hegde Nagar were hit from behind by a BBMP garbage truck on Thanisandra Main Road and died on the spot; the truck driver was arrested.
incidents.cause: garbage truck hit scooter from behind while it slowed behind a car
incidents.quote: Two sisters, who were going to a hospital in Ramakrishna Hegde Nagar, died after a BBMP garbage truck hit them on Thanisandra Main Road in Hennur traffic police limits.

incidents.what_happened: A 42-year-old man on his way to office was knocked down by a speeding truck on Hebbal flyover and died in hospital; the truck driver was arrested.
incidents.quote: A 42-year-old man died after he was knocked down by a speeding truck on Hebbal flyover.

incidents.what_happened: A parked car's door was flung open into a scooter near a timber shop in Pantarapalya; the 47-year-old woman riding pillion fell and was crushed by the rear wheel of a BMTC bus behind; her brother was injured.
incidents.cause: dooring by parked car; BMTC bus following close behind
incidents.quote: While passing by a timber shop in Pantarapalya, the driver of a parked car suddenly opened the front door, which hit the scooter.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding cement mixer truck hit an elderly couple's two-wheeler from behind as they turned right near Kodipalya Circle, ran over them and dragged the bike about 200 m; both died on the spot.
incidents.quote: A couple died on the spot after a cement mixer truck collided with their two-wheeler and crushed them.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding BMTC bus rammed an autorickshaw from behind, crushing it against another BMTC bus that had slowed ahead; the auto driver and an 80-year-old passenger died on the spot.
incidents.quote: In a horrific incident, an auto driver and an 80-year-old passenger, who was an Ayurvedic doctor died on the spot, when an autorickshaw they were travelling got stuck between two BMTC buses.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding tanker truck lost control around 4 am near the Satellite Bus Stand, hit parked cabs, a car, the median, an autorickshaw and a pedestrian; the truck driver died and two were injured.
incidents.quote: In a serial accident, a 40-year-old truck driver died, two were injured, and over five vehicles were damaged.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding bike crashed into a roadside tree near the Ayyappa Swamy Temple on BEL Road around 4.10 am; the 25-year-old pillion rider died of head injuries and the rider was seriously hurt.
incidents.quote: A 25-year-old man from Assam died after the speeding bike he was riding pillion crashed into a roadside tree.
incidents.spot: BEL Road near Ayyappa Swamy Temple

incidents.place: Thanisandra Main Road near railway bridge, Hennur
incidents.what_happened: A 10-year-old boy riding pillion with his father was run over by a BBMP garbage truck and died on the spot; a mob assaulted the driver, who later died, and set the truck on fire.
incidents.cause: garbage truck ran over child on two-wheeler
incidents.quote: The 59-year-old garbage truck driver who was assaulted following the death of a 10-year-old boy in a road accident succumbed to injuries on Tuesday night.

incidents.place: Dhobi Ghat junction, Chord Road, Vijayanagar
incidents.what_happened: A 48-year-old pourakarmika crossing Chord Road under the Shivanagar flyover at 6.25 am was run over by a tipper lorry that moved off as the signal turned green; the driver abandoned the lorry and fled.
incidents.cause: tipper lorry accelerated at signal without seeing pedestrian; driver fled
incidents.quote: A 48-year-old pourakarmika was killed on the spot after she was run over by a tipper lorry in Vijayanagar traffic police limits on Tuesday morning.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding milk tanker driven by a drunk driver hit a scooter near the BEL underpass; the 17-year-old pillion rider fell and was run over by the rear wheels, his 16-year-old friend was seriously injured.
incidents.quote: A 17-year-old pillion rider lost his life, and his friend was injured when a speeding milk tanker collided with their scooter, causing the teenager to fall and be run over by the rear wheels of the tanker.

incidents.place: Old Airport Road near ISRO URSC, Murugeshpalya
incidents.what_happened: A BMTC bus on route 335E ran over a Rapido bike-taxi rider and his pillion passenger near the U R Rao Satellite Centre around 10 pm; both were declared dead and the bus crew fled.
incidents.cause: BMTC bus hit bike taxi; possible overspeeding; crew fled
incidents.quote: Two men on a bike taxi were allegedly run over by a Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) bus on Old Airport Road in Bengaluru Wednesday night.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding ambulance hit two pushcarts, an autorickshaw and a scooter on BTS Road around 8.30 am; a 48-year-old pushcart vendor died and six were injured. The driver claimed brake failure.
incidents.cause: speeding ambulance; driver claimed brake failure
incidents.quote: A 48-year-old pushcart vendor died while six others sustained injuries after a speeding ambulance collided with two pushcarts, an autorickshaw and a scooter on the busy BTS Road in Wilson Garden traffic police station limits around 8.30 am on Thursday.

incidents.what_happened: After a 3.50 am argument at a tea stall over a cigarette, a drunk car driver followed two techies on a bike and rammed it; the 29-year-old rider hit his head on a shop shutter and died days later. Police treated it as murder.
incidents.cause: drunk driver deliberately rammed bike after scuffle (road rage)
incidents.quote: A 29-year-old techie was killed, while his friend survived the murder bid after a drunk man crashed his car into their bike.

incidents.what_happened: An overspeeding KSRTC bus lost control at a turn, jumped the median onto the service road, hit oncoming two-wheelers and overturned in a drain; a 55-year-old traffic sub-inspector died and four were injured.
incidents.quote: The accident occurred in Kaggalipura on the Bengaluru-Kanakapura main road on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: Around 1.40 am an overspeeding 16-wheel boulder truck hit a garbage truck stalled on the right side of the Kodigehalli flyover, then a cab; the garbage truck toppled onto its driver, who died, and two were injured.
incidents.cause: overspeeding truck hit vehicle stalled on flyover
incidents.quote: The incident happened on the Kodigehalli flyover on the International Airport Road near Brigade Magnum around 1.40 am.

incidents.what_happened: A 38-year-old service agent died when his two-wheeler rammed the rear of a tractor at high speed near the Ullal bridge on NICE Road around 10.50 am.
incidents.quote: The incident occurred near the Ullal bridge on NICE Road around 10.50 am.

incidents.what_happened: A 19-year-old died after a speeding truck collided with his two-wheeler near 4th Block, SMV Layout around 1.30 pm.
incidents.quote: The incident took place near 4th Block, SMV Layout, around 1.30 pm.

incidents.what_happened: Around 1.30 am a speeding motorcyclist lost control on the BGS flyover and rammed an electric scooter ahead; both riders (26) died and both pillion riders were injured, one seriously.
incidents.quote: Two motorcyclists died in a road accident on BGS flyover in City Market traffic police limits on Tuesday.

incidents.what_happened: A police sub-inspector standing beside a car whose tyre had come off at 2.35 am near Yallammanagar was hit from behind by an unidentified truck; he died in hospital five days later.
incidents.cause: hit-and-run by unidentified truck at night; stranded vehicle
incidents.quote: A 39-year-old Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) from Thalaghattapura police station, who sustained injuries in an accident while he was taking two suspected drug peddlers for spot mahazar in Anekal on June 24 and was hospitalised, succumbed to injuries on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A family on a two-wheeler stopped near 8th Mile so the 21-year-old wife could drink water; a drunk lorry driver ran her over and tried to flee before passersby stopped him. Her husband and baby survived.
incidents.quote: A 21-year-old woman died on the spot when a lorry knocked her down near 8th Mile after Hesaraghatta Cross in Peenya traffic police station limits on Thursday afternoon.

incidents.what_happened: A BMTC electric bus moved by its conductor while the driver was away veered right and ploughed into women at a roadside eatery near Peenya 2nd Stage bus stop; a 26-year-old bank employee died and four were injured, two critically.
incidents.cause: conductor (not the assigned driver) drove BMTC e-bus and lost control
incidents.quote: In an outrageous instance of incompetence and fickle fortune, the conductor of a BMTC electric bus ploughed into pedestrians at a roadside eatery, killing a 26-year-old woman and seriously injuring others near Peenya 2nd Stage bus stop on Friday morning.

incidents.place: Kogilu Main Road near Maruthinagar, Yelahanka
incidents.what_happened: A scooter carrying a mother and two daughters skidded on Kogilu Main Road; the 10-year-old girl fell under the rear wheels of a BMTC bus behind and died on the spot.
incidents.cause: scooter skidded; BMTC bus behind ran over child
incidents.quote: A 10-year-old girl died on the spot after she was run over by a BMTC bus on Kogilu Main Road near Maruthinagar under Yelahanka traffic police station limits at 8.20 am on Thursday.

incidents.what_happened: At 12.30 am a speeding car on the wrong side hit a couple's scooter on the Bachahalli Gate flyover; the 31-year-old woman was thrown about 20 feet off the flyover and died on the spot. The car driver fled.
incidents.quote: A 31-year-old woman died after a speeding car on the wrong side rammed into a two-wheeler, causing her to fall from the Bachahalli Gate flyover under the Devanahalli traffic police station limits at 12.30 am on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding truck hit the rear of a bike taxi at 2 am near Krishnananda Nagar Junction; the 22-year-old passenger died and the rider was injured. The truck driver fled.
incidents.quote: The incident occurred near Krishnananda Nagar Junction under Rajarajeshwari Nagar Traffic Police Station limits at 2 am on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A BMTC bus heading to Town Hall hit a two-wheeler on SJP Road around 6.40 pm; the 11-year-old pillion rider fell and was run over by the rear wheel, dying on the spot. It was the fifth BMTC bus accident in two weeks.
incidents.quote: A 11-year-old boy died after a BMTC bus ran over him near SJP Road under Halsuru Gate police station limits at around 6.40 pm on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A lorry with suspected brake failure ploughed into a bike, an autorickshaw and a car at Sumanahalli Junction; the auto driver and his daughter were killed on the spot and a biker was seriously injured. The driver absconded.
incidents.cause: speeding lorry, suspected brake failure; driver fled
incidents.quote: In a horrific accident, a 45-year-old autorickshaw driver and his 24-year-old daughter were killed on the spot after a speeding lorry ran over several vehicles near Sumanahalli Junction under Kamakshipalya traffic police station limits on Saturday morning.

incidents.what_happened: A 26-year-old software engineer heading home around 11.45 pm failed to notice a road hump, lost control of his speeding two-wheeler and hit the divider near Jnanabharathi junction; he died in hospital.
incidents.cause: speeding; unnoticed road hump at night
incidents.quote: Two men, including a software engineer, died in separate road accidents in the city on Saturday night.

incidents.place: Ganapathi Temple Road near Magadi Road, Kamakshipalya
incidents.what_happened: A 12-year-old boy cycling after school skidded while trying to avoid a rashly driven mini tipper lorry and came under its rear wheels, dying on the spot; the driver abandoned the vehicle and fled.
incidents.cause: hit-and-run; rash and negligent mini tipper
incidents.quote: A 12-year-old boy, who was going on his bicycle to meet his friend after school, was mowed down by a mini tipper lorry on the Ganapathi Temple Road near Magadi Road in Kamakshipalya traffic police station limits at 3.30 pm on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: A 22-year-old final-year B Com student fell from her scooter while trying to avoid loose gravel on a poorly maintained road near Budigere Cross and came under a truck, which sped away; the driver was later arrested.
incidents.cause: bad road / loose gravel; truck driver fled (hit-and-run)
incidents.quote: She fell from the scooter while trying to avoid loose gravel on a poorly maintained road near Budigere Cross in the Avalahalli police station limits on Monday.

incidents.place: Near Austin Town, Neelasandra-Mother Teresa Road
incidents.what_happened: A 50-year-old autorickshaw driver driving on the wrong side at night hit a parked car and then a moving cab near Austin Town; he died of head injuries and two passengers were hurt.
incidents.quote: A 50-year-old autorickshaw driver died after his vehicle collided with a cab while he was driving on the wrong side from Neelasandra towards Mother Teresa Road near Austin Town in the Ashoknagar Traffic police station limits.

incidents.what_happened: A 62-year-old autorickshaw driver lost control while taking a sharp right turn at 8.14 pm behind Govindaraja Nagar police station and died of head injuries.
incidents.quote: The incident occurred near 17th Cross Road, behind the Govindaraja Nagar police station, under the Vijayanagar Traffic police station limits, at 8.14 pm.

incidents.what_happened: A truck swerved to avoid a pothole on the poorly maintained Huskur Main Road and brushed a bike's handle; the 26-year-old bank employee riding pillion fell under the truck's wheels and died on the spot.
incidents.cause: truck swerving to avoid pothole on badly restored road
incidents.quote: The poorly maintained Huskur Main Road near Golden Palms Hotel and Resort in Alur near Nelamangala claimed the life of a 26-year-old bank employee on Friday morning.
incidents.spot: Huskur Main Road near Golden Palms, Alur

incidents.what_happened: A speeding container truck carrying cable-drilling machinery and labourers overturned at a turn on Uraganadoddi Road; the driver and a machine operator were trapped and killed, four were critically injured.
incidents.quote: Two men died and four others were injured after a speeding container truck they were travelling in overturned, while taking a turn.

incidents.place: City Palace Junction / Richmond Circle, Double Road
incidents.what_happened: Around 11 pm a speeding private ambulance with no patient rammed two-wheelers waiting at a red signal, crushing a couple to death, injuring two, dragging a bike 40 m and hitting a police booth. The driver fled and was later arrested.
incidents.quote: A couple was killed on the spot and two others were injured after a speeding ambulance rammed their two-wheelers and damaged a police booth.
incidents.spot: City Palace Junction, Kengal Hanumanthaiah Road

incidents.place: Railway underpass near Judicial Layout, Yelahanka
incidents.what_happened: A 35-year-old software engineer's bike skidded around 10.30 pm near Judicial Layout and he hit a pole; the ambulance could not pass the narrow railway underpass, he was carried by car to it and was declared dead on arrival.
incidents.cause: bike skid at night; ambulance blocked by badly designed underpass (golden-hour delay)
incidents.quote: The incident happened near Judicial Layout in Yelahanka around 10.30 pm on Wednesday.

incidents.what_happened: Two women road-work labourers crossing NICE Road after work around 6.15 pm were knocked down by a speeding SUV and died on the spot; the driver fled and was traced via CCTV. There is no pedestrian crossing on the stretch.
incidents.cause: hit-and-run; speeding SUV; no pedestrian crossing on NICE Road
incidents.quote: In a hit-and-run case, two women labourers died on the spot after being hit by a speeding SUV.

incidents.what_happened: A 17-year-old riding his father's motorcycle without a helmet and overspeeding hit three pedestrians crossing near the airport toll plaza around 6.30 pm, fell and died of head injuries; a woman pedestrian suffered a fractured thigh.
incidents.quote: The minor, who was riding his father’s Bajaj Pulsar, hit three pedestrians 100 meters from the airport toll plaza in Devanahalli, before falling and rolling on the road, around 6.30pm on Sunday.

incidents.place: Tin Factory BMTC bus stand, KR Puram
incidents.what_happened: A BMTC electric bus hit a two-wheeler from behind near the Tin Factory bus stand at 9.32 am; the 25-year-old pillion rider was run over and died in hospital.
incidents.cause: BMTC e-bus hit two-wheeler from behind
incidents.quote: The incident happened near the Tin Factory BMTC bus stand on Friday at 9.32 am.

incidents.what_happened: A private school bus driver fleeing after hitting an autorickshaw rammed a scooter; two girls aged four and two fell under the front wheels and died during treatment. Police stopped the driver as he tried to escape again.
incidents.cause: school bus driver fleeing an earlier crash
incidents.quote: Two girls, aged four and two, died after they were mowed down by a school bus near the police quarters in Hegde Nagar in Hennur traffic police limits around 8.10 am on Wednesday.

incidents.place: Tumakuru Road flyover near Jindal Hospital, Madanayakanahalli
incidents.what_happened: Around 11.30 pm a speeding car carrying five young friends hit the divider on the Tumakuru Road highway flyover, jumped to the other side and crashed into a KSRTC bus; all five (aged 17-23) died. Bus passengers escaped.
incidents.cause: speeding at night; lost control, crossed divider
incidents.quote: The accident occurred on the Tumakuru–Bengaluru National Highway flyover in front of Jindal Hospital in the Madanayakanahalli police limits.

incidents.what_happened: Around 1.15 am a speeding sedan failed to notice a road hump and crashed into the rear of a cement truck near Agara Cross; all three 22-year-old occupants died.
incidents.cause: high speed at night; unnoticed road hump
incidents.quote: Three youth died after their speeding car rammed into the rear of a truck, near Agara cross in the Kaggalipura police station limits, on Sunday.

incidents.place: Outside RR Medical College, Bengaluru-Mysuru Road, Kengeri
incidents.what_happened: An overspeeding tipper lorry hit two medical students on a scooter outside RR Medical College at 4.15 pm; the 22-year-old pillion rider fell under its wheels and died, the rider was injured. The driver was arrested.
incidents.quote: A 22-year-old medical student died while her friend sustained grievous injuries in a road accident outside her college in Kengeri traffic police station limits at 4.15 pm on Wednesday.

incidents.what_happened: A goods carrier speeding down a narrow lane knocked down a four-year-old girl walking hand-in-hand with her mother to a temple; she died on the spot.
incidents.cause: speeding goods vehicle on narrow lane
incidents.quote: A four-year-old girl died in front of her mother in a road accident at Hanumanthagowdanapalya in Madanayakanahalli area on Saturday morning.

incidents.what_happened: A 21-year-old engineering student riding home after dinner around 11.15 pm rammed a truck parked on the main road without indicators and died.
incidents.cause: truck parked on road at night without indicator lights
incidents.quote: The accident occurred around 11.15pm on Friday in front of a hotel on the Uttarahalli-Kengeri main road.

incidents.what_happened: A bike rider on his way to work around 6 am lost control and rammed a concrete mixer mounted on a goods vehicle ahead on the Byatarayanapura flyover; he died on the way to hospital.
incidents.quote: A 32-year-old bike rider died after hitting a concrete mixing machine that was fixed to a goods vehicle on the Byatarayanapura flyover at around 6 am on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: Two construction labourers who got off a private bus stopped on the highway around 5.45 am were knocked down by a speeding motorbike while crossing the road and died on the spot. The rider, the bus driver and NHAI officials (for an open barricade) were booked.
incidents.cause: speeding bike; bus stopping on highway; open median barricade
incidents.quote: Two men were killed after a speeding motorbike crashed into them while they were crossing the Bengaluru–Ballari main road near Vidyashilp Cross in Yelahanka traffic police limits on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A 27-year-old man watching a temple procession at about 5.30 am was hit by a tractor carrying a deity as it turned on a sloping road; he fell under its wheels and died. The tractor driver fled.
incidents.cause: tractor driver lost control on slope; driver absconded
incidents.quote: The mishap occurred in Hulimavu traffic police station limits on Wednesday night.

incidents.what_happened: A 60-year-old ex-serviceman died when a truck hit his scooter near Hebbagodi bus stop around 6.15 am.
incidents.quote: Four people, including an ex-serviceman, died in separate road accidents on Tuesday and Wednesday in Devanahalli, Electronics City and Chikkajala traffic police limits.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding tractor's trailer hit the handlebar of a scooter ridden by two 16-year-olds at 8.45 pm; the rider fell and was run over, dying on the spot. The tractor driver fled.
incidents.quote: In a hit-and-run case, a 16-year-old boy died and his friend sustained injuries after a tractor allegedly brushed against their scooter on RTO Road in the Mico Layout traffic police limits.
incidents.spot: RTO Road near Vijaya Bank Layout Circle

incidents.place: Near SMVT Railway Station, JB Nagar
incidents.what_happened: A 15-year-old riding a motorcycle collided head-on with a scooter near SMVT (Baiyappanahalli) station at 8.30 pm and died of head injuries.
incidents.quote: A 15-year-old boy riding a motorcycle died after colliding with a scooter near SMVT Railway Station in JB Nagar traffic police limits on Saturday night.

incidents.what_happened: A truck hit two college students' two-wheeler from behind on NICE Road; the 19-year-old B Tech student died and his classmate was injured. The truck driver fled.
incidents.cause: hit-and-run; truck hit two-wheeler from behind
incidents.quote: The 19-year-old college student died and his classmate suffered injuries when a truck hit their two-wheeler from behind on NICE Road in Hulimavu traffic police limits on Monday afternoon.

incidents.what_happened: Around 3.45 am a garment-laden truck from Rajasthan lost control near the up-ramp of the Hebbal flyover and rammed a truck ahead; its 26-year-old driver died on the spot and his friend was injured.
incidents.cause: lost control at night; rear-ended truck
incidents.quote: A truck driver from Rajasthan died and his friend suffered injuries when his vehicle rammed another truck moving ahead near the Hebbal flyover on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: A 36-year-old plumber returning home around 11 pm died after his motorcycle was hit by a goods rickshaw near Seshadripuram.
incidents.cause: goods rickshaw hit motorcycle at night
incidents.quote: A 36-year-old plumber died when his motorcycle was hit by a goods rickshaw near Seshadripuram on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A goods auto turned suddenly towards a petrol bunk and a scooter rammed it from behind; a three-year-old boy standing in front on the scooter died and his mother was critically injured.
incidents.cause: goods auto turned suddenly; child carried standing in front of scooter
incidents.quote: In a heart-wrenching accident, a three-year-old boy was killed, and his 25-year-old mother was critically injured after the two-wheeler she was riding rammed a goods auto from behind near MRPL petrol bunk on the Attibele-Sarjapur Road between 10.45am and 11am on Wednesday.

incidents.place: Tin Factory flyover, Outer Ring Road
incidents.what_happened: Around 3 am a 16-year-old on a borrowed motorcycle sped on the ORR flyover from Tin Factory towards Kasturinagar, hit the safety barricade and was thrown off the flyover; he was declared dead.
incidents.cause: underage rider speeding at night; thrown over flyover barricade
incidents.quote: In a tragic incident, a 16-year-old boy who had left his house without informing his parents, fell from the Tin Factory flyover after speeding on a two-wheeler and crashing into the safety barricade in the early hours of Tuesday.

incidents.place: Super Market Circle, HMT Layout, Yeshwanthpur
incidents.what_happened: A speeding goods vehicle rammed a 35-year-old man's motorcycle near Super Market Circle around 4.45 am; he was declared dead in hospital.
incidents.quote: A 35-year-old private company employee was killed after a goods vehicle collided with his motorcycle near HMT Layout in the Peenya traffic police station limits on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: A 39-year-old security guard crossing the road after work near Gandhi Circle was hit by a water tanker and died in hospital; the driver was taken into custody.
incidents.quote: The incident occurred on Varthur-Gunjur Main Road under the Whitefield traffic police station on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: While her elder sister got off a school van around 4.15 pm, a five-year-old girl came close and was crushed under its front wheel when the driver moved forward; he abandoned the van and fled.
incidents.cause: hit-and-run; school van moved off while child near wheel
incidents.quote: A five-year-old girl was run over by a school van near Dasanapura underpass in Chikkabanavara traffic police limits on Wednesday evening.

incidents.what_happened: A speeding water tanker turning near Yelahanka New Town bus stop hit a 67-year-old's scooter from behind around 8.30 am and ran over him; his two grandchildren escaped with minor injuries. The driver abandoned the tanker and fled.
incidents.quote: In the first incident, a 67-year-old man, who was on his way to drop his two grandchildren at school, was killed after a water tanker hit his scooter and ran over him.

incidents.what_happened: A 79-year-old man crossing Puneeth Rajkumar Ring Road around 2.30 pm was knocked down by a speeding goods truck and died in hospital six days later.
incidents.quote: In another incident, a 79-year-old man, who was knocked down by a speeding goods truck while crossing the road, succumbed to his injuries on Friday.

incidents.what_happened: A BMTC electric bus with alleged brake failure rammed a parked autorickshaw near KR Circle in the afternoon and then hit an electric pole; the 60-year-old auto driver inside died in hospital.
incidents.quote: A 60-year-old autorickshaw driver was killed after a BMTC electric bus rammed his parked autorickshaw due to alleged brake failure near KR Circle on Saturday afternoon.

incidents.place: Gandhi Marga, Bengaluru University Jnana Bharathi campus
incidents.what_happened: A 23-year-old first-year PG student crossing Gandhi Marga near the campus canteen was hit by a speeding autorickshaw; she died in ICU six days later, prompting student protests to restrict public traffic through the campus.
incidents.cause: speeding autorickshaw on public road through campus
incidents.quote: Hundreds of students at Bengaluru University’s Jnana Bharathi campus protested on Wednesday following the death of a first-year postgraduate student who was seriously injured in a road accident on the campus on Thursday and died on Wednesday.

incidents.what_happened: A scooter rider braked suddenly behind a car around 9 am near Ananthanagar; his 32-year-old pillion colleague fell and was run over by an oncoming mini goods vehicle, whose driver fled. Residents blamed potholed roads; police said there was no pothole at the exact spot.
incidents.cause: hit-and-run; sudden braking on poor road (pothole link disputed by police)
incidents.quote: Hundreds of residents of Ananthanagar staged a protest on Wednesday night, alleging that poor road infrastructure led to the death of a woman after a goods vehicle ran over her near Ananthanagar, within the limits of Electronics City Traffic Police Station, on Wednesday morning.

incidents.place: Vignana Nagar Junction, Kaggadasapura Main Road
incidents.what_happened: A 33-year-old biker waiting at a signal around 9.40 am was crushed between two cars when a speeding car driven by a 62-year-old rammed the car behind him; the driver said he pressed the accelerator instead of the brake.
incidents.cause: pedal confusion; speeding car rear-ended queue at signal
incidents.quote: A 33-year-old biker, who was waiting at a traffic signal, was crushed to death by a speeding car which rammed into his motorcycle on Kaggadasapura Main Road, within the Jeevan Bima Nagar traffic police station limits, on Monday morning.
incidents.spot: Vignana Nagar Junction, Kaggadasapura Main Road

incidents.what_happened: Around 6.30 am a helmetless motorcyclist lost control on a curve of the Silk Board double-decker flyover and hit the retaining wall; he died of head injuries.
incidents.quote: A private firm employee died after he allegedly lost control of his speeding motorcycle and rammed into the retaining wall of the Silk Board double-decker flyover, within the Madiwala traffic police station limits, in the early hours of Sunday.

incidents.place: CKB Layout, Marathahalli-Sarjapur Outer Ring Road
incidents.what_happened: A 30-year-old cook's scooter went out of control while entering the ORR from the service road near CKB Layout and hit a tree; he died and his pillion rider was seriously hurt.
incidents.cause: lost control merging from service road
incidents.quote: In another incident, a 30-year-old man died, and his pillion rider sustained serious injuries after their scooter went out of control and crashed into a roadside tree near the Marathahalli-Sarjapur Outer Ring Road (ORR), within the HAL Airport traffic police station limits, on Sunday morning.

incidents.place: Near JK Basavanna Circle, Shyamarajapura, Yelahanka
incidents.what_happened: A speeding car entered a one-way road and hit a motorcycle around 7.20 pm; the Class 10 pillion rider died of head injuries and the 17-year-old rider was seriously injured.
incidents.cause: car driving wrong way on one-way road
incidents.quote: The student died after a car allegedly driven recklessly on a one-way road collided with the motorcycle he was riding pillion in Yelahanka traffic police limits around 7.20 pm on Sunday.
incidents.spot: New BDA Layout road, JK Basavanna Circle

incidents.what_happened: Around 1 am an unidentified speeding vehicle rear-ended a motorcycle on the Bommasandra flyover, killing both riders (28 and 25); the driver fled and police are checking CCTV.
incidents.quote: Two people died after an unidentified speeding vehicle rammed into their motorcycle on the Bommasandra flyover under Electronic City Traffic Police limits in the early hours of Saturday.
